rules.statement: An application to Court under the Entail and Settlement Ordinance, 1876, for sale of a property subject to a fidei commissum is not a lis in the sense required for the purposes of the doctrine of lis pendens.
rules.supporting_quote: "An application to Court under the Entails and Settlements Ordinance, 1876, for sale of a premises for Rs. 10,000, and to invest the money in the purchase of some other property, subject to the same conditions. After due inquiry the Court on April 16, 1919, allowed the application, and the property was sold to the plaintiff by deed dated April 17,1919."
